status: audit complete; 127 fixes proposed, 55 held and 10 blocked for operator decision; no data/, sim/ or ui/ change made
question: Which numeric leaves in data/*.json store less than the full game precision of their Frosty source value?
operatorRule: Site data stores the full source precision; rounding belongs only in UI display (operator, 28 Sep 2026).

criterion.direct: Full precision when struct.unpack("<f", struct.pack("<f", site)) equals the source float32. The shortest decimal that round-trips is full precision (830.769 for 830.768982). Integers must be equal.
criterion.conversion: Full precision when site equals float64(source float32) * factor (or the shortest repr of that double). Rounded conversions are violations; the error is reported, and class sub-f32 means site/factor still parses to the source float32.
criterion.derived: Stored derived values (tacRld = ReloadTimeBulletsLeft / ReloadSpeed, bolt-cycle rpm, ADS ladder, overrides) are compared with the formula evaluated in float64 from the float32 source operands. When the formula reduces to one float32 operand (divisor exactly 1.0) the direct rule applies. sub-f32 means f32(site) equals f32(formula); beyond-f32 means it does not.
criterion.outOfScope: Leaves with no source field (software contracts, project metadata, observations, schema versions, labels) are counted by ledger review status only.

method: Enumerate every numeric non-Boolean leaf of the 11 data/*.json files (data/provenance/ and Boolean/string leaves excluded).

Join to the 23 September site-input ledger by file + JSON pointer (65,266 rows, 50,464 of them numeric). Follow each row's embedded raw operands (byte offset + 4-byte hex) instead of its rounded sourceValue copies.
Compare as float32/int32/uint32 (criterion above). Unit conversions restricted to x1000, x100, x-1 and their inverses.

Families whose ledger rows carry only 6-decimal decoder copies were re-decoded from raw bytes with an unrounded subclass of scripts/frosty-ebx-decode.py: ADS_MOVE_TIERS, MOVING_ACC_TIERS (ZDA_Moving_Weapons), HIP_SPREAD_TABLE (HDA_Weapons), WME_WSway_P05, the WME_SpotRange_2D3D minimap factors.

COLLATERAL_MULT_OVERRIDE (327 leaves, generated by scripts/frosty-collateral.py): the ten-value table read from both 1.4.3.0 material grids (Class_6aa794ef array); the game stores 0.166667, 0.333334, 0.500001, 0.571429, 0.750001, 0.833334 as float32, so the generated values are exact.

Derived families evaluated from float32 operands quoted in the ledger: weapons tacRld, emptyRld, recoilV, bolt-cycle rpm, db12 burstBurstsPerMinute; ADS_SPD_TIERS (ledger candidate formula 1000*AZTT + 2*(1000/60)); subsonicVelocityMps (fraction x base velocity); tacRldOverrideMs (1000*time/speed).
Re-read a sample of operands with scripts/frosty-raw-check.py (48 reads, listed below) and end-to-end checked 18 random exact leaves (site value vs the raw value).

Display impact: repo sim modules (applyAttachments, loadout, core, weapon-attributes) driven over all 63 weapons x every single mag, ammo, ergo, barrel and muzzle selection (1,687 builds) with unmodified and patched copies of data/, comparing the strings the UI formatters produce (Fire Rate map, Tac Reload toFixed(3), ADS/deploy/undeploy/sprint ms, Recoil/Shot toFixed(2), spot ranges, velocity, collateral, TTK for BTK 1-40, burst tooltip, four attribute scores). Repo untouched; patched copies live in the external run folder.

separateFindings.finding: BROD 3 rpm 830.7692307692307 is the 10800/13 estimate rule, never replaced by the source RateOfFire 830.768982. Not a decimal rounding of the source; the value differs by 2.5e-4 rpm (3e-7 relative). Test pins it.

light_supp and cqb_supp store minimapSpotMult 0.14, but the source effect factor is 0.10 for DRSIAR and M2010ESR (2 of 54 selections each; ledger status candidate-mismatch). Weapon-specific data question, not precision.

The four MOVING/ADS/DRAW/HDA arrays and the collateral table are exact; the generator scripts/frosty-hit-zones.py:197 and scripts/frosty-global-operands.py:143 round decoded floats to 6 decimals, but no stored hit-zone or collateral value is affected (782 of 782 hit-zone multipliers are float32-exact).

sim/ rounds computed results at 3-6 decimals (applyAttachments.js:409, 410, 421, 498, 499, 617; core.js:319). These are calculations, not stored data leaves; not audited. Minimap Spot 64.28571 vs 64.285714 is the visible artifact of the minimapSpotMult rounding above.
The 77 ammo.json collateralMult class defaults (0.75, 0.57, 0.33) are 2-decimal inactive fallbacks of table values 0.750001, 0.571429, 0.333334; no source field by design.

limits: ADS_SPD_TIERS uses the ledger's candidate formula (AZTT seconds x 1000 + two 60 Hz frames); field meaning and the two-frame term remain unproven (ledger: precisely-blocked-source). The proposal removes only the 3-decimal rounding of that candidate.
Exact status of the ledger-matched leaves rests on raw bytes recorded by the 23 September audit plus 48 fresh reads; it does not re-derive every field path.
Display checks cover single-selection builds over the formatters in ui/app.js and ui/format.js, not every combination and not the canvas drawings.
Source values are serialized configuration; runtime consumption is out of scope.
